# upwind_threat_skill (Data Source)

Reads the metadata of a single Upwind threat Agent Skill by name. The skill body itself is a zip download and is not exposed.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# One skill by name. Useful as a precondition: fail the plan if something the
# automation depends on is no longer published.
data "upwind_threat_skill" "policy_manager" {
  name = "threat-policy-manager"
}

check "skill_is_available" {
  assert {
    condition     = data.upwind_threat_skill.policy_manager.version != ""
    error_message = "The threat-policy-manager skill is not published in this organization."
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Unique identifier for this skill, e.g. `threat-policy-manager`. Also the path segment used to download it.

### Read-Only

- `description` (String) What this skill does and when an agent should use it. Agents match against this text when deciding whether the skill is relevant.
- `version` (String) The skill's published version.
